zen-browser.changelog:
# Zen Stable Release


## Security
- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-130/

## New Features
- Updated to Firefox 160.0.1
- The copy URL and copy URL as Markdown shortcuts now copy the URLs of all selected tabs when multiple tabs are selected.

## Fixes
- Fixed boosts color tinting and controls not working. ([#16586](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/16586))
- Fixed closed browser and popup windows never being freed from memory, which made memory usage and pauses grow over time. ([#16587](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/16587))
- Switching spaces is now smooth when spaces use gradient themes, instead of being choppy. ([#13029](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/13029))
- Fixed tabs shown in a split view or behind a glance being unloaded when memory runs low. ([#16624](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/16624))
- Fixed Spaces Sync for spaces and pinned tabs assigned to the built-in containers (Personal, Work, Banking, Shopping) on profiles that don't have them. Missing containers are now created when needed. ([#16614](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/16614))
- Fixed the copy URL shortcut copying "about:blank" while a page is still loading. ([#16510](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/16510))
- Improved performance when opening new windows with mods installed. ([#16674](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/16674))
- Fixed thin lines in PDFs printing as thick black boxes on some printers on Windows.
- Fixed PDFs, web page graphics, and WebGL content appearing blank or broken on Macs with AMD graphics, such as black cells in Google Sheets.
- Fixed incorrect colors in WebGL and canvas content, such as games and Google Meet backgrounds, on some Linux systems using Wayland.
- Fixed links on some sites, such as the Google Store, taking a very long time to load.
- Fixed tabs crashing on some sites, most notably ChatGPT.
- Fixed WebTransport connections being unable to send datagrams after a site sent many in quick succession.
- Fixed trackpad and mouse swipes sometimes scrolling the page when a site had blocked scrolling.
- More bug fixes and improvements.

## Changes
- The zoom level button is now hidden in the single toolbar layout. A toast shows the current zoom level when you change it instead.

ankidroid.changelog:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> GitHub does not auto-update apps


## For regular users

Install `arm64-v8a` from the **Assets** section below. If it fails to install, use `Parallel.A`.

`Parallel` builds install side-by-side with the main APK, allowing you to use different settings and profiles (via the `AnkiDroid directory` advanced setting and a different AnkiWeb login).


## For testers

The builds with `full`, `play` and `amazon` are useful for testing our builds for different app stores:

- **`full`**: F-Droid & GitHub `Parallel` apks
- **`play`**: Google Play - does not have `MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE` permission as it is forbidden by Google, on uninstall the user is invited to delete data.
- **`amazon`**: Amazon - currently same as full, historically removed `CAMERA` permission


## ABI variants

We perform ABI splits to reduce APK size. In rare cases, a phone may not be using the `arm64-v8a` ABI. You can find your phone's ABI using [kamgurgul/cpu-info](https://github.com/kamgurgul/cpu-info). If disk space isn't an issue, use the `full` apk.

## 新功能

- 简易模式合并到本地配置，支持直接以 Mihomo YAML 保存配置，并新增本地配置重新加载按钮
- 新增 MCP 服务，支持配置端口及访问令牌

- 新增 InternetData 网络 IP 信息查询源
- 支持配置可信订阅的 YAML 别名解析上限
- 新增 Linux 便携 tarball 压缩包

## 优化

- 切换到本地配置时增加 DNS 覆写确认提示
- 订阅到期日期跟随系统区域格式显示
- 调整应用会话缓存位置，统一存放到缓存目录
- 点击标题栏时自动收起已打开的菜单

## 修复

- 修复本地配置未正确继承受控设置、受控设置优先级及出站模式保留问题
- 修复标准资源中代理集合缺失，以及更新代理集合后代理组未刷新的问题
- 修复关闭 use-hosts 后仍保留 hosts 覆写的问题
- 修复未加引号的 REALITY short-id 被错误解析为数字的问题
- 修复 macOS 启动时 DNS 保护未刷新，以及内核已有权限时重复授权失败的问题
- 修复 Windows 管理员重启时授权提示异常及取消授权后应用退出的问题
- 修复 Windows 管理员权限检测超时后错误缓存结果的问题
- 修复 Windows 内核清理可能影响其他程序或其他用户会话中内核进程的问题
- 修复旧版 Windows 开机启动任务提示文件不存在的问题
- 修复 Windows 轻量模式下关机后系统代理未关闭的问题
- 修复 Windows 绝对资源路径识别及准备脚本路径包含空格时的问题

## 安全

- 限制外部链接可打开的协议

- 更新依赖

hiddify.changelog:
# Highlights - **A smarter Keep top.** Only the fastest proxies run and the others are parked. A kept proxy that stops answering is replaced, and the parked ones are checked again every hour. Client endpoints, WARP included, take part too. - **21 new languages.** Nine more translations are now complete. - **Lighter on CPU and battery.** Animations stop when nobody can see them. The connect button's light costs much less to draw. The core uses only as many processors as its load needs and paces the reads of busy connections. - **OpenVPN profiles.** The app reads `.ovpn` files and `ovpn://` links. - **Psiphon gets through more often.** As the first hop, Psiphon scans CDN edges with Chrome's TLS handshake and connects through the ones that answer. You can change its country from the home page. - **WARP keeps searching, and can search deeper.** WARP searches for up to 3 minutes and learns which noise and tunnel work on each network. When a WARP or Psiphon search finds nothing, the app offers a deep search. - **Proxies that are not secure are marked.** A proxy that anyone on the way can read gets a red *Not secure* mark that explains why. The list shows each proxy's transport and security, such as `VLESS · XHTTP · REALITY`. - **Subscriptions download on hard networks.** The core downloads them with Chrome's TLS handshake. When a download fails, the app says why and what to try. - **The desktop core runs in a process of its own.** The app's core is a library in the app, and only the proxies run in the engine. If the engine crashes, the app stays open, shows why it crashed and recovers. - **VPN mode by default on desktop.** When VPN mode needs administrator permission, the app asks with a clear choice. On Linux it works without pkexec, and it also works in the AppImage. - **Router mode on Linux.** A transparent proxy for a whole network. - **Linux arm64, RPM and one install script.** There are deb, rpm and AppImage builds for x64 and arm64. A single `install.sh` for macOS and Linux verifies what it downloads. - **Report a problem from the app.** A report carries every log and the crash. It can first turn on 10 minutes of detailed logging. The core encrypts the report, and you send it by Telegram or email, or keep it on your device. - **A beta channel.** GitHub pre-releases go only to users who join the beta channel. The update dialog shows the change log, and every download is checked against its SHA-256 before it is installed. - **A newer core.** xray-core v26.11.9, a Chrome 155 fingerprint, and ECH that works with every fingerprint. Fake IPs survive a restart of the core. Many crash and hang fixes for XHTTP, WARP, Psiphon, AmneziaWG and WireGuard. - **Steadier on every platform.** When the core stops by itself, Android, iOS and macOS take the VPN down cleanly and say why, and a desktop VPN service that hangs has its engine stopped. Android gives the core a quarter of the device's RAM, so connections no longer lag. The Quick toggle and always-on VPN start the core properly. ## Downloads **Download based on your OS:** **بر اساس سیستم عامل خود دانلود کنید:**

clash-nyanpasu.changelog:
> 简体中文版本请展开页面底部的「简体中文」。 ## Read Before Upgrading - **With TUN on, the TUN stack chosen in Clash settings now takes precedence over a Profile's `tun.stack`.** Previously a stack written by the subscription won. If you relied on it, choose the stack in settings instead (the default is gVisor). - **A Profile that sets a TUN stack the selected core rejects now fails to apply, with an error naming the value and the supported ones.** For example, `tun.stack: mixed` or `mips` under Clash Premium, which would otherwise make the core reject the whole config. This is checked even while TUN is off, because the core parses the key on load. Values Nyanpasu does not know are still passed to the core. - **The stack selector only lists the stacks the current core reads**, and is hidden for clash-rs and Meow, which ignore the key. If the saved stack is not supported by the core you switch to, gVisor is used and a warning is written to the log; the saved setting is kept. - **Service mode now requires nyanpasu-service 2.0.2.** An installed 2.0.1 service is upgraded once at startup. 2.0.2 fixes a stale pid record that made the service and the app fail on every start (#6033). ## Highlights - **Mips (Mihomo IP Stack)**, mihomo's new user-space TUN stack, can be selected under mihomo and mihomo-alpha, together with its TCP congestion controller (CUBIC, Reno, BBR, BBRv3, or the core default). The controller is remembered when you switch to another stack and back (#6091). - **Startup failures no longer crash the app.** A dialog names the file, the cause and the recovery steps, and can open the containing, backup or log folder. Corrupt local data and an unusable jobs journal are rebuilt instead of blocking startup. ## [2.0.1] - 2026-10-31 ### ✨ Features - **config:** Add the mips TUN stack and its congestion controller (#6098) by @greenhat616 in [#6098](https://github.com/libnyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/pull/6098) - **config:** Decide the TUN stack from each core's config features (#6097) by @greenhat616 in [#6097](https://github.com/libnyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/pull/6097) - **settings:** Offer the TUN stacks and mips options the core reads (#6099) by @greenhat616 in [#6099](https://github.com/libnyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/pull/6099) - **startup:** Report failures in a dialog instead of panicking (#6063) by @greenhat616 in [#6063](https://github.com/libnyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/pull/6063) - **windows:** Bundle the Windows App SDK bootstrapper with enableLoopback (#6043) by @greenhat616 in [#6043](https://github.com/libnyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/pull/6043) ### 🐛 Bug Fixes - **jobs:** Rebuild an unusable jobs journal instead of failing to start (#6069) by @greenhat616 in [#6069](https://github.com/libnyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/pull/6069) - **service:** Require service 2.0.2 (#6045) by @greenhat616 in [#6045](https://github.com/libnyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/pull/6045) - **startup:** Handle environment failures before and around setup (#6064) by @greenhat616 in [#6064](https://github.com/libnyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/pull/6064) - **startup:** Rebuild corrupt local data instead of failing to start (#6062) by @greenhat616 in [#6062](https://github.com/libnyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/pull/6062) - Align update link with header menu (#6109) by @keiko233 in [#6109](https://github.com/libnyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/pull/6109) - Prevent logo animation edge artifacts (#6041) by @keiko233 in [#6041](https://github.com/libnyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/pull/6041) - Prevent page title artifacts while scrolling (#6040) by @keiko233 in [#6040](https://github.com/libnyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/pull/6040) - Prevent sparkline stretching on new peaks (#6039) by @keiko233 in [#6039](https://github.com/libnyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/pull/6039) ### 📚 Documentation - **config:** Design core feature queries and the TUN mips stack (#6096) by @greenhat616 in [#6096](https://github.com/libnyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/pull/6096) - **design:** Add domain error design notes (#6083) by @greenhat616 in [#6083](https://github.com/libnyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/pull/6083) - Plan startup failure handling without setup panics (#6060) by @greenhat616 in [#6060](https://github.com/libnyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/pull/6060) ### 🔨 Refactor - **setup:** Report startup failures as domain errors (#6061) by @greenhat616 in [#6061](https://github.com/libnyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/pull/6061) ----------------- **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/libnyanpasu/clash-nyanpasu/compare/v2.0.0...v2.0.1
简体中文 ## 升级前须知 - **开启 TUN 时，Clash 设置中选择的 TUN 堆栈现在优先于 Profile 中的 `tun.stack`。** 以前订阅写入的堆栈会覆盖设置。如果你依赖订阅指定堆栈，请改在设置中选择（默认为 gVisor）。 - **Profile 设置了当前内核不支持的 TUN 堆栈时，配置现在会生成失败，错误信息会列出该值与内核支持的值。** 例如在 Clash Premium 下写 `tun.stack: mixed` 或 `mips`，否则内核会拒绝加载整份配置。由于内核加载配置时就会解析这个键，TUN 关闭时也会检查。Nyanpasu 不认识的值仍会原样交给内核。 - **堆栈选择器只列出当前内核会读取的堆栈**，clash-rs 与 Meow 不读取该键，因此不再显示选择器。如果保存的堆栈不被切换后的内核支持，运行时改用 gVisor 并在日志中记录警告，保存的设置不变。 - **服务模式现在需要 nyanpasu-service 2.0.2。** 已安装的 2.0.1 服务会在启动时自动升级一次。2.0.2 修复了残留的 pid 记录导致服务与应用每次启动都失败的问题（#6033）。 ## 主要变更 - **Mips（Mihomo IP Stack）**：mihomo 新增的用户态 TUN 堆栈，可在 mihomo 与 mihomo-alpha 下选择，并可设置 TCP 拥塞控制算法（CUBIC、Reno、BBR、BBRv3 或内核默认）。切换到其他堆栈再切回时，该设置会保留（#6091）。 - **启动失败不再导致应用崩溃。** 对话框会说明出错的文件、原因与恢复步骤，并可打开所在目录、备份目录或日志目录。损坏的本地数据与不可用的任务日志会被重建，不再阻止启动。 - 修复了 Logo 动画边缘、滚动时页面标题与流量迷你图拉伸的显示问题；更新链接与顶部菜单对齐。 - Windows 安装包随 enableLoopback 附带 Windows App SDK 引导程序。 完整的变更列表见上方英文部分。
